name: admin-assets-search
js: const q = 'courtyard'; const box = document.querySelector('#assets-search'); box.value = q; box.setAttribute('value', q); document.querySelectorAll('.picture-list__item').forEach((e) => { if (!e.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(q)) e.remove(); }); document.querySelector('.page-header .subtitle').textContent = '1 asset';
